content:
[32603 Systems Quality Management | Subject description]
Credit points: 6

This subject teaches you to plan, implement, and enhance quality management processes, crucial for ensuring product integrity in complex production landscapes. You'll learn how quality management systems (QMS) are integral to organisational management, permeating various layers and functioning within firms. With an emphasis on the intricacies of software and systems products, the subject uses real-world examples and culminates in an industry project where you'll address and propose solutions to a QMS problem.

[32603 Systems Quality Management | Learning and teaching activities]
Lectures are available online. The lectures provide foundation knowledge of quality management that can, and probably will, be applied when investigating and solving a commercial quality management problem.

 During the tutorials problem will be presented for students to suggest ways to respond to the different stages of problem investigation. The student responses will be summarised to inform discussion about the investigation.

 The main learning activity of this subject is for group (4-5 students) of students to investigate and develop responses to a problem provided. Each week student teams will develop another phase of their investigation and suggested solution to the problem.

title: Learning outcomes
content:
[32603 Systems Quality Management | Learning outcomes]
SLO1: Analyse the value and costs of quality in a specific context. (D.1)
SLO2: Using a quality model describe those qualities that are important in a specific context. (D.1)
SLO3: Describe how quality management, control and improvement can be implemented in a specific context. (D.1)
SLO4: Determine and describe the practical considerations for quality management in a specific context. (D.1)
SLO5: Apply some of the current research issues in software quality. (D.1)
